description: Use this to see the workspace's studies, answer "what's running?", or find the study_id another tool needs: lists the 20 newest studies, each with its study_id and status (draft, live (in field), in review or completed); search and status narrow those 20. It starts nothing.

search.description: Match those studies by name, e.g. "content ROI". If none matches, the whole list comes back instead (up to 20 studies), whatever their status.

status.description: Only studies with this status (live matches "live (in field)").

name: gather_list_studies
title: List your GatherHQ studies
